title: heft migration: lichen Rust workspace unbuildable - patched oscore crate observe API exists only in uncommitted Mac working tree
description: Found while running t8ox verification on heft (blocks ALL lichen Rust builds on heft, not just t8ox). rust/Cargo.toml [patch.crates-io] points oscore at /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/oscore (Mac). Heft mirror /home/mark/crates/oscore was fast-forwarded 2026-08-30 to fork origin/main 7434512, which has the edhoc-schnorr48 feature but NOT the observe-response API: rust/lichen-node/src/secure.rs:1361 calls Context::begin_unprotect_observe_response, which per bead project-LICHEN-worker6-2hn1 was implemented 2026-08-28 ONLY in the Mac working tree of /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/oscore/src/lib.rs and never committed/pushed (github.com/MarkAtwood/rust-oscore main has no observe code; ls-remote shows only main@7434512). Repro on heft: cd rust && cargo test -p lichen-node -> error[E0599] no method named begin_unprotect_observe_response. No copy of the modified source exists anywhere on heft (searched ~ for the symbol). Fix: on the Mac, commit+push the observe-response work to the fork (git push), then on heft: cd /home/mark/crates/oscore && git pull. Also unset: worker worktrees need the local uncommitted rust/Cargo.toml patch-path swap to /home/mark/crates/oscore (workers 1/6/7 already carry it; do NOT commit that path swap - it would break Mac builds; consider making the patch path machine-agnostic via a .cargo/config.toml [patch] later). Note CARGO_TARGET_DIR must override rust/.cargo/config.toml /Volumes/Attic target-dir on heft.
close_reason: Fixed on heft by the 9liz round: the missing observe API was ported to the heft oscore clone and captured in-repo, restoring all lichen Rust builds. Evidence: (1) bead's claimed symptom 'no copy of the modified source exists anywhere on heft' is now false - rg finds begin_unprotect_observe_response 5x in /home/mark/crates/oscore/src/lib.rs and 5x in the committed patches/rust-oscore-local.patch (commit 3fa372c19e). (2) The bead's exact repro now passes: cd rust && cargo test -p lichen-node compiles (E0599 gone) and secure::tests::protected_observe_registration_notifications_retries_blocks_and_reset passes; cargo check clean for lichen-gateway, lichen-node, lichen-cli. CARGO_TARGET_DIR override to /home/mark/Cache/cargo-target used per the bead's note; rust/Cargo.toml patch-path swap to /home/mark/crates/oscore carried uncommitted per the bead's instruction (also per worker1/worker7 convention). (3) The port was reviewed 3x by independent reviewer agents during the 9liz round (findings ythw P1, xhnx P2, jb4i P4 filed against it); no files were touched this round beyond last round's already-reviewed patch, so no new review passes were run - noting per protocol. The prescribed upstream push from the Mac remains desirable but is an upstream write needing Mark; filed as follow-up project-LICHEN-worker6-trsk (reconcile Mac original vs heft port, push, retire local patch, optional machine-agnostic patch path with the cargo [patch]-in-config caveat).
